image_description: A close-up shot of a large, spherical soap bubble in the foreground. The bubble exhibits strong iridescence with swirling patterns of blue, green, pink, and gold. It reflects and distorts the background, which includes blurred figures of people (one holding a wand) and an urban landscape with a dome-shaped building in the distance. The lighting suggests daylight.
